facts.statement: Scipionyx was a theropod dinosaur that lived in Italy during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 113 million years ago.
facts.quote: Scipionyx ( ) was a genus of theropod dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous Pietraroja Formation of Italy, around 113 million years ago.

facts.statement: Only one fossil of Scipionyx is known, discovered in 1981 by an amateur paleontologist and introduced to the scientific community in 1993.
facts.quote: There is only one fossil known of Scipionyx, discovered in 1981 by an amateur paleontologist and brought to the attention of science in 1993.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was the first dinosaur ever discovered in Italy.
facts.quote: It was also the first dinosaur found in Italy.

facts.statement: The adult form and size of Scipionyx remain unknown.
facts.quote: Its adult form and size is unknown.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was a bipedal predator with a horizontal rump balanced by a long tail.
facts.quote: Scipionyx was a bipedal predator, its horizontal rump balanced by a long tail.

facts.statement: Researchers believe Scipionyx was covered in primitive feathers, though no skin remains have been found in the fossil.
facts.quote: Its body was probably covered by primitive feathers but these have not been found in the fossil, that is without any skin remains.

facts.statement: Half-digested meals preserved in the fossil's gut indicate that Scipionyx ate lizards and fish.
facts.quote: In the guts of the fossil some half-digested meals are still present, indicating Scipionyx ate lizards and fish.

facts.statement: Scientists have disagreed on how Scipionyx breathed, based on the position of its internal organs.
facts.quote: Several scientists have tried to learn from the position of the internal organs how Scipionyx breathed, but their conclusions often disagree.

facts.statement: The generic name Scipionyx means "Scipio's claw", combining the Latin name Scipio and the Greek word onyx.
facts.quote: The generic name Scipionyx comes from the Latin name Scipio and the Greek ὄνυξ, onyx, the combination meaning "Scipio's claw".

facts.statement: In 2021, Andrea Cau proposed that the Scipionyx holotype is a hatchling carcharodontosaur.
facts.quote: In 2021, the Italian paleontologist Andrea Cau proposed that the holotype of Scipionyx is a hatchling carcharodontosaur.

facts.statement: In 2024, Andrea Cau published a study placing Scipionyx in a polytomy with Wiehenvenator, Iberospinus, and other Spinosauridae.
facts.quote: Later, in 2024, Cau published a new paper that recovered Scipionyx in a polytomy with Wiehenvenator, Iberospinus, and the rest of Spinosauridae.

facts.statement: The preserved length of the Scipionyx holotype is estimated at just 23.7 cm.
facts.quote: The holotype of Scipionyx represents a very small individual, the preserved length of which is estimated at just 23.7 cm.

facts.statement: In 2011, researchers estimated the total length of Scipionyx, including the missing tail, at 46.1 cm.
facts.quote: In 2011, dal Sasso and Maganuco estimated its total length, including the missing tail section, at 46.1 cm.

facts.statement: The hatchling would have fit in an egg approximately 11 cm long and 6 cm wide, suggesting a large egg size relative to the adult body.
facts.quote: As the hatchling would have fitted within an egg about 11 cm long and 6 cm wide, this would have implied a rather high egg size compared to the adult body length.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was a small bipedal predator with a long slender neck, elongated hindlimbs, and especially elongated forelimbs.
facts.quote: Scipionyx was a small bipedal predator. Its horizontal rump was balanced by a long tail. The neck was relatively long and slender. The hindlimbs and especially the forelimbs were rather elongated.

facts.statement: A 2011 study identified eight unique derived traits that distinguish Scipionyx from its closest relatives.
facts.quote: The 2011 study established eight unique derived traits or autapomorphies in which Scipionyx differed from its closest relatives.

facts.statement: The first finger of Scipionyx is conspicuously elongated, measuring 23% longer than the third finger.
facts.quote: The first finger is conspicuously elongated, 23% longer than the third finger.

facts.statement: The holotype skull is large relative to the body and short with very large eye sockets.
facts.quote: The skull of the holotype is large, compared to the size of the body, and short with very large eye-sockets.

facts.statement: The premaxilla bone carries five teeth.
facts.quote: The premaxilla, the bone forming the front of the snout, carries five teeth.

facts.statement: The animal has a total of forty-four teeth in its head, with twenty-two on each side.
facts.quote: Scipionyx has five teeth in the premaxilla, seven in the maxilla and ten in the dentary of the lower jaw for a total of twenty-two per side and a grand total for the head of forty-four.

facts.statement: Having five premaxillary teeth is surprising because four is the normal number for compsognathids, and only some Carnosauria typically have five.
facts.quote: The number of five premaxillary teeth is surprising, as a total of four is normal for compsognathids: otherwise, only some Carnosauria have five.

facts.statement: Because the specimen was young and had not yet started its tooth replacement cycle, it displayed perfect dental symmetry between the left and right jaws.
facts.quote: Due to the young age of the specimen, the tooth replacement cycle had not started yet, causing a perfect dental symmetry between the left and the right jaws.

facts.statement: The teeth generally curve gradually rather than having the typical sudden recurving apex of compsognathids, though the largest teeth show a slight kink.
facts.quote: The teeth lack the typical compsognathid shape with a suddenly recurving apex of the tooth crown. Instead, in general they curve gradually; only the largest teeth show something of a "kink".

facts.statement: The second and fifth premaxillary teeth are the largest in that row.
facts.quote: The second and fifth teeth are the largest.

facts.statement: The fourth maxillary tooth is the largest tooth of the entire head.
facts.quote: The second and fourth maxillary teeth are the largest; the latter being the largest tooth of all.

facts.statement: A conspicuous diamond-shaped fontanelle exists between the frontals and parietals, which was initially mistaken for damage caused during fossil preparation.
facts.quote: Between the frontals and the parietals the skull roof over a limited distance has not closed yet, resulting in a conspicuous diamond-shaped opening, a fontanelle that was first mistaken for damage inflicted on the fossil during the first preparation.

facts.statement: The lower jaw is straight and elongated.
facts.quote: The lower jaw is straight and elongated.

facts.statement: In the 1998 description, misidentification of jaw bones due to displacement created a false impression that an external mandibular fenestra was present.
facts.quote: In the 1998 description a part of the splenial was mistaken for a supradentarium and the angular was misidentified as the surangular because in the fossil it had been displaced upwards, creating the false impression an external mandibular fenestra, an opening in the outer side of the jaw, would be present.

facts.statement: The vertebral column likely consists of ten cervical vertebrae and thirteen dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: The vertebral column of Scipionyx probably includes ten cervical vertebrae and thirteen dorsal vertebrae

facts.statement: Five sacral vertebrae are definitively present in the specimen.
facts.quote: With certainty five sacral vertebrae are present

facts.statement: Only nine tail vertebrae are preserved, though the animal likely originally had fifty or more.
facts.quote: The fossil has preserved just nine tail vertebrae; likely fifty or more had been originally present

facts.statement: The neck vertebrae have an opisthocoelous shape.
facts.quote: The neck vertebrae are opisthocoelous

facts.statement: The axis vertebra features a pneumatopore, an opening allowing air sacs to reach its hollow interior.
facts.quote: The axis is pneumatised as a pneumatopore, an opening through which a diverticulum of the air sack of the neck base could reach its hollow interior, is visible on its side

facts.statement: Cervical ribs are exceptionally long, reaching up to three vertebral centra in length.
facts.quote: Contrary to what was stated by the 1998 study, the cervical ribs are very elongated, with a length of up to three vertebral centra

facts.statement: Dorsal vertebrae are not pneumaticized and have an oval cross-section with low, hexagonal spines.
facts.quote: The vertebrae of the back are not pneumatised. They are amphiplatyan with an oval cross-section and bear low spines with a hexagonal profile

facts.statement: A small beak-shaped process is located just below the top of the dorsal spine on both front and back edges.
facts.quote: Just below the top of the spine on the front and back edge a small beak-shaped process is present

facts.statement: In the thirteenth vertebra, the parapophysis and diapophysis are unusually positioned at the same level.
facts.quote: Exceptionally, with the thirteenth vertebra the two rib joint processes, the parapophysis and the diapophysis, are positioned at the same level

facts.statement: The five sacral vertebrae have not fused into a complete sacrum.
facts.quote: The five sacral vertebrae have not yet fused into a real sacrum

facts.statement: Tail vertebrae are platycoelous, featuring low spines and backward-slanting chevrons.
facts.quote: The tail vertebrae are platycoelous with low spines and backward slanting chevrons

facts.statement: The gastralia form a herringbone pattern that allows the abdominal basket to expand and contract for breathing.
facts.quote: The gastralia form a herringbone pattern, the left and right medial elements overlapping each other at their forked ends in order that the basket can expand and contract to accommodate the breathing movements of the abdomen

facts.statement: The furcula is broad, U-shaped, and has branches angled at 125 degrees.
facts.quote: The furcula is broad and more or less U-shaped with its two branches angled at 125°

facts.statement: The forelimb is relatively long, measuring 48% of the body length anterior to the pelvis.
facts.quote: The forelimb is rather long; its length is equal to 48% of the body length in front of the pelvis

facts.statement: While the hand is elongated like typical compsognathids, Scipionyx has a relatively short hand for its group.
facts.quote: Especially the hand is elongated as is typical for compsognathids; for a member of that group Scipionyx has a relatively short hand, however

facts.statement: The ulna is slender, cylindrical, and 70% the length of the humerus.
facts.quote: The ulna is slender and cylinder-shaped with a length of 70% of that of the humerus

facts.statement: The wrist consists of only two elements: a radial bone and a disc-shaped bone below it.
facts.quote: The wrist consists of two elements only: a radial bone capping the lower end of the radius and a disc-shaped bone below it

facts.statement: The ilium is short, flat, and has a slightly convex upper profile.
facts.quote: The ilium is short and flat with a slightly convex upper profile

facts.statement: The pubic bone points almost vertically downward, classifying it as mesopubic or orthopubic.
facts.quote: The pubic bone points almost vertically downwards and is thus "mesopubic" or "orthopubic"

facts.statement: The ischium is three-quarters the length of the pubis and is set at a 54-degree angle to it.
facts.quote: The ischium has three quarters the length of the pubis, set at an angle of 54° to it

facts.statement: A large, hatchet-shaped obturator process is present on the front of the ischium shaft.
facts.quote: On the front of its shaft a large hatchet-shaped obturator process is present

facts.statement: The femur is straight and robust.
facts.quote: The femur or thigh bone is straight and robust

facts.statement: The tibia has a weak cnemial crest separated from the outer condyle by a deep narrow groove called the incisura tibialis.
facts.quote: The tibia has only a weak cnemial crest, separated from its outer condyle by a deep narrow groove, the incisura tibialis

facts.statement: Scipionyx is unique for preserving examples from most major internal organ groups, including blood, vessels, cartilage, muscles, and digestive and respiratory systems.
facts.quote: Scipionyx is unique in preserving in some form examples from most major internal organ groups: blood, blood vessels, cartilage, connective tissues, bone tissue, muscle tissue, horn sheaths, the respiratory system and the digestive system

facts.statement: Soft tissues are preserved as three-dimensional petrifications replaced by calcium phosphate, detailed down to the subcellular level.
facts.quote: The soft tissues are not present in the form of imprints but as three-dimensional petrifications, having been replaced by calcium phosphate in amazing detail, even to the subcellular level

facts.statement: Calcium phosphate mineralization preserved the structure of original bone cells, including osteocytes with inner hollow spaces and canaliculi.
facts.quote: The original bone tissue is no longer present but the calcium phosphate mineralisation has preserved the structure of original bone cells, showing individual osteocytes including their inner hollow spaces and the canaliculi

facts.statement: Six vertebrae are capped by cartilaginous synchondroses, a feature typical of juveniles.
facts.quote: Six vertebrae are visibly capped by cartilaginous synchondroses, a typical juvenile feature

facts.statement: The only preserved respiratory element is a seven-millimeter-long piece of trachea with about ten visible rings.
facts.quote: The sole element still present consists of a seven millimetre long piece of the trachea of which about ten tracheal rings are visible

facts.statement: The tracheal rings have an average length of 0.33 millimeters and are separated by 0.17-millimeter-thick interspaces.
facts.quote: They have an average length of 0.33 millimetres and are separated by 0.17 millimetre thick interspaces

facts.statement: The trachea is very thin, with a preserved width of one millimeter, about half the expected width for an animal of this size.
facts.quote: The trachea is quite thin, with a preserved width of one millimetre about half as wide as would be expected for an animal the size of the holotype

facts.statement: A conspicuous red halo, roughly circular with a diameter of seventeen millimeters, is visible in the front of the thorax.
facts.quote: In the front part of the thorax a conspicuous red halo is visible, forming a roughly circular stain with a diameter of seventeen millimetres

facts.statement: Analysis confirmed the red pigment was limonite, a transformation product of original hemoglobin.
facts.quote: a scanning electron microscope analysis indicated that the substance consisted of limonite, hydrated iron oxide, a likely transformation product of the original haemoglobin

facts.statement: Biliverdine, a bile component expected in the liver, was also present in the fossil.
facts.quote: Also biliverdine was present, a bile component expected in the liver

facts.statement: Traces of the thymus might be present, contributing to a greyish organic mass visible in the neck base.
facts.quote: Another organ in the thorax, traces of which might be present, is the thymus, which might have contributed to a greyish mass of organic origin visible in the neck base

facts.statement: A five millimetre series of food particles indicates the position of Scipionyx's oesophagus.
facts.quote: The position of the oesophagus is indicated by a five millimetre long series of small food particles.

facts.statement: A cluster of prey bones below the ninth dorsal vertebra marks the location of Scipionyx's stomach.
facts.quote: Below the ninth dorsal vertebra the location of the stomach is shown by a cluster of bones of prey animals

facts.statement: The backward position of prey bones suggests Scipionyx had a dual stomach structure with a proventriculus and a muscular gizzard.
facts.quote: The rather backward position of the cluster suggests the stomach was dual in structure, with a forward enzyme-secreting proventriculus preceding a muscular gizzard.

facts.statement: No gastroliths have been reported in the Scipionyx fossil.
facts.quote: Gastroliths have not been reported.

facts.statement: A large, thick intestine identified as the duodenum is preserved just behind the stomach area.
facts.quote: Just behind the presumed position of the stomach a very conspicuous large and thick intestine is visible, that has been identified as the duodenum.

facts.statement: A subsequent intestine part interpreted as the jejunum is found nearby and slightly above the duodenum.
facts.quote: Nearby and slightly above, a subsequent intestine part surfaces that has been interpreted as the jejunum.

facts.statement: A contraction below the thirteenth dorsal vertebra may indicate the transition to the rectum.
facts.quote: A contraction below the thirteenth dorsal vertebra might indicate the transition to the rectum.

facts.statement: Faeces are still present in the final part of the preserved digestive tract.
facts.quote: In this final part faeces are still present.

facts.statement: The fossil lacks a cloaca.
facts.quote: The cloaca is lacking.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest the large empty space between the pubic shafts and intestines was filled by the hatchling's yolk sac in life.
facts.quote: According to Dal Sasso & Maganuco, in life this space would have been filled by the yolk sac of the hatchling

facts.statement: Preserved muscle tissue shows exceptional detail, including individual fibres, cells, and subcellular sarcomeres.
facts.quote: The degree of preservation is often exceptional, with not only the individual fibres still discernible but also the individual cells and even the subcellular sarcomeres.

facts.statement: Scipionyx is one of only two dinosaur fossils with preserved sarcomeres, though Santanaraptor has muscle fibres four times as thick.
facts.quote: Among dinosaur fossils such sarcomeres are only known from Santanaraptor, whose muscle fibres are four times as thick.

facts.statement: Muscle fibres identified as the Musculus sternohyoideus and Musculus sternotrachealis are present at the neck base.
facts.quote: In the grey organic mass at the neck base, muscle fibres are present that have been identified as belonging to the Musculus sternohyoideus and the Musculus sternotrachealis.

facts.statement: Horizontal unsegmented muscle fibres above the rectum likely represent the Musculus caudofemoralis longus, the main tail retractor muscle.
facts.quote: Above the rectum tract a large area of horizontal unsegmented muscle fibres is present, probably representing the unsegmented Musculus caudofemoralis longus of the tail base, the main retractor muscle operating on the thighbone.

facts.statement: Connective ligaments forming the ligmamentum interhaemale, small muscle fibres, and mysterious herringbone-patterned hollow tubes are found below tail base vertebrae.
facts.quote: Below some tail base vertebrae the connective ligaments between the chevrons are present, forming the ligmamentum interhaemale, but also some small muscle fibres and some mysterious hollow tubes arranged in a herringbone pattern

facts.statement: Horn sheaths are visible on all preserved claws, though the foot claws are missing.
facts.quote: On all claws preserved in the fossil — those of the feet have all been lost — horn sheaths are visible.

facts.statement: Hand claw sheaths extend the bony cores by about 40%, curving like a scythe to end in sharp points.
facts.quote: The horn sheaths of the hand claws extend the bony cores by about 40%, scythe-like continuing the bone curve and ending in sharp points.

facts.statement: The darker top colouration of the claw sheaths suggests original horn material is still present.
facts.quote: These have a darker colouration on top than on the bottom which suggests that the original horn material is still present

facts.statement: The fossil preserves no traces of skin, scales, or feathers.
facts.quote: The fossil preserves no traces of any skin, scales or feathers.

facts.statement: In 1999, Philip J. Currie hypothesized that tubes on the tail base represented protofeather filaments.
facts.quote: In 1999 Philip J. Currie hypothesised this might be otherwise, suggesting the tubes found on the tail base would represent the filaments of protofeathers.

facts.statement: In 2011, Dal Sasso & Maganuco rejected the protofeather hypothesis because the tubes taper at both ends, unlike expected integument filaments.
facts.quote: In 2011, however, Dal Sasso & Maganuco rejected this interpretation because the tubes taper at both ends, while integument filaments are expected to have only a tapered top end.

facts.statement: Despite rejecting the direct evidence, researchers considered it likely Scipionyx had protofeathers based on their presence in related compsognathids.
facts.quote: Nevertheless, they considered it likely that Scipionyx in life had protofeathers as these are known to be present with the compsognathids Sinosauropteryx and Sinocalliopteryx.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was originally assigned to the Coelurosauria group of theropods.
facts.quote: Scipionyx was by the describers assigned to the Coelurosauria, a group of theropods.

facts.statement: A 2011 analysis indicated Scipionyx was a basal member of the Compsognathidae and the sister species of Orkoraptor.
facts.quote: Part of the 2011 monograph was a cladistic analysis which indicated that Scipionyx was a basal member of the Compsognathidae and the sister species of Orkoraptor.

facts.statement: In 2021, Andrea Cau proposed a re-evaluation of Scipionyx's classification and the Compsognathidae group.
facts.quote: In 2021, a study proposed by Andrea Cau re-evaluated the classification of this specimen and the classification of compsognathids in general.

facts.statement: Cau applied a new classification procedure to Scipionyx to obtain a phylogenetic position unaffected by its immaturity.
facts.quote: In his study, Cau proposes a new procedure to classify these animals, applying it to Juravenator, Scipionyx and Sciurumimus, obtaining a possible phylogenetic position that was not affected by the immaturity of the specimens.

facts.statement: Under Cau's new procedure, Scipionyx is classified as a carcharodontosaurid rather than a compsognathid.
facts.quote: According to this new procedure, Juravenator and Sciurumimus turn out to be megalosauroids, while Scipionyx turns out to be a carcharodontosaurid.

facts.statement: Cau's classification explains the small size of the Scipionyx specimen as consistent with large carcharodontosaurid juveniles rather than small adult compsognathids.
facts.quote: Furthermore, this location would explain the size discrepancy between the Scipionyx type specimen and the estimated adult size for the presumed adult compsognathids, more in line with the size of the large carcharodontosaurids.

facts.statement: Scipionyx lived during the Albian period in an area that was part of the Apulian Plate and largely covered by the shallow Paratethys sea.
facts.quote: The location where Scipionyx was found, in the Albian was part of the Apulian Plate, at the time largely covered by the shallow Paratethys.

facts.statement: Researchers concluded that Scipionyx generally inhabited small islands formed by dry land amidst shallow marine sediments.
facts.quote: From this it has been concluded that the habitat of Scipionyx in general consisted of small islands

facts.statement: Scipionyx was considered one of the larger animals within its specific island ecosystem.
facts.quote: it represented one of the larger animals of its ecosystem

facts.statement: Dal Sasso and Maganuco suggested Scipionyx was likely a recent immigrant from North Africa rather than a permanent resident of the islands for millions of years.
facts.quote: Dal Sasso & Maganuco did not consider Scipionyx to have been a permanent resident of small islands throughout tens of millions of years, but more likely a recent immigrant arriving during a dispersal wave, probably from North-Africa.

facts.statement: The Scipionyx fossil preserves a complete series of consecutive meals, providing direct evidence of its diet.
facts.quote: The fossil provides direct information about the diet of Scipionyx because remains of a complete series of consecutive meals have been preserved

facts.statement: About eight scales and some bone fragments were found in the oesophagus tract of the Scipionyx specimen.
facts.quote: In the oesophagus tract about eight scales and some bone fragments are present.

facts.statement: Two clusters of lizard scales and a fish vertebra were found in the descending tract of the duodenum.
facts.quote: In the descending tract of the duodenum two clusters of lizard scales are present and, more below, a fish vertebra.

facts.statement: Faeces in the rectum contained a piece of skin with seventeen scales from a nine-season-old fish of the Osteoglossiformes.
facts.quote: The final tract of the rectum still holds faeces in which a piece of skin is visible showing seventeen scales of a fish of the Osteoglossiformes that was nine seasons old, judging from the growth lines on the scales.

facts.statement: The variety of food items found indicates that Scipionyx was an opportunistic generalist predator.
facts.quote: Together they represent a varied diet showing that Scipionyx was an opportunistic generalist.

facts.statement: If the prey was forty centimetres long, it is unlikely the hatchling could have subdued it alone, suggesting parental care.
facts.quote: If the prey animal in the stomach really was forty centimetres long, it is highly unlikely that the equally-sized hatchling had been able to subdue it, indicating parental care.

facts.statement: The specimen's liver was preserved as a red hematite halo retaining its original shape from when the animal was alive.
facts.quote: The specimen's liver was preserved in the form of a red hematite halo retaining the shape it had when the animal was alive.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen provides unique direct information about non-avian dinosaur physiology, specifically regarding digestion, respiration, and ontogenesis.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen thus provides unique direct information about the physiology of non-avian dinosaurs, especially regarding the digestion, the respiration and the ontogenesis.

facts.statement: The shorter-than-expected length of the intestines indicates Scipionyx could process food very efficiently.
facts.quote: The overall length of the intestines — shorter than what was expected — indicates Scipionyx could process food very efficiently.

facts.statement: The lack of etching on stomach bones indicates the meal was less than a day old.
facts.quote: The bones in the stomach region had not been etched by the stomach acid, indicating this meal was less than a day old.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the stomach exit was too narrow to pass remains and if acid was used to extract calcium for a growing young animal.
facts.quote: It is possible that the stomach exit was too narrow to let these remains pass and that the acid was used to extract calcium from the bones, a much-needed nutrient for a young growing animal.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the hatchling instinctively sought out calcium-rich fish or was preferentially fed fish by its parents.
facts.quote: Fish contains much calcium and it is possible that the hatchling instinctively sought it out; alternatively, it could have been preferentially fed fish by its parents.

facts.statement: Only one fossil of Scipionyx is known, discovered in 1981 by an amateur paleontologist and brought to scientific attention in 1993.
facts.quote: Sólo se conoce un fósil de Scipionyx, descubierto en 1981 por un paleontólogo aficionado y llamado la atención de la ciencia en 1993.

facts.statement: The discovery generated significant publicity due to the unique preservation of large areas of petrified soft tissue and internal organs such as muscles and intestines.
facts.quote: El hallazgo generó mucha publicidad debido a la preservación única de grandes áreas de tejido blando petrificado y órganos internos como músculos e intestinos.

facts.statement: The fossil represents a juvenile individual that was half a meter long and possibly only three days old.
facts.quote: El fósil es el de un juvenil de solo medio metro de largo y quizás solo de tres días de edad.

facts.statement: Partially digested food found in the fossil's abdomen indicates that Scipionyx ate lizards and fish.
facts.quote: En las entrañas del fósil todavía están presentes algunas comidas a medio digerir, lo que indica que Scipionyx comió lagartijas y pescado.

facts.statement: The fossil preserves detailed internal structures, including the internal architecture of some muscle and bone cells.
facts.quote: El fósil muestra muchos detalles de estos, incluso la estructura interna de algunas células musculares y óseas.

facts.statement: It was the first dinosaur discovered in Italy.
facts.quote: También fue el primer dinosaurio encontrado en Italia.

facts.statement: Scipionyx is classified within the family Compsognathidae.
facts.quote: familia: Compsognathidae

facts.statement: The genus Scipionyx was named by dal Sasso and Signore in 1998.
facts.quote: genus_authority: dal Sasso & Signore, 1998

facts.statement: The classification of Scipionyx is uncertain due to the difficulties of classifying a taxon known only from a juvenile specimen.
facts.quote: La clasificación de Scipionyx es incierta, debido a las dificultades de clasificar un taxón conocido solo de un espécimen tan joven.

facts.statement: One researcher has proposed that Scipionyx may belong to the family Carcharodontosauridae, a group of large carnosaurs.
facts.quote: un investigador ha propuesto que puede pertenecer a Carcharodontosauridae, una familia de grandes carnosaurios.

facts.statement: John Ruben's conclusions regarding the respiratory system have been questioned by scientists like Lawrence Witmer, who claimed the study was flawed.
facts.quote: John Ruben's conclusions have, however, been questioned by some scientists, such as Lawrence Witmer, who claimed the study to be flawed.

facts.statement: A 2011 study concluded that the liver's exact dimensions and extent could not be determined because it was preserved as a vague halo of body fluids.
facts.quote: The 2011 study concluded that due to the fact that the liver had been preserved as a vague halo, representing body fluids that after death might have covered a larger surface than the organs they originated from, its exact dimensions and extent cannot be determined.

facts.statement: The presumed M. diaphragmaticus muscle was shown to be an artifact caused by the polishing of non-organic calcite nodules during fossil preparation.
facts.quote: The presumed M. diaphragmaticus was shown to be an artifact caused by the polishing and engraving of calcite nodules of non-organic origin during preparation, creating the illusion of muscle fibres.

facts.statement: G.S. Paul and David Martill hypothesized that the space between the pubic bones and intestines was the location of a large air-sac.
facts.quote: The empty space between the pubic bones and the intestines has by G.S. Paul and David Martill been hypothesised to have been the location of a large air-sac.

facts.statement: Dal Sasso & Maganuco rejected the air-sac hypothesis, arguing that in living birds the posterior abdominal air-sac does not force the intestines forward.
facts.quote: Dal Sasso & Maganuco however, rejected this interpretation because with living birds the air-sac of the posterior abdomen does not force the intestines forwards.

facts.statement: Air-sacs were considered probable due to the pneumatization observed in the vertebrae.
facts.quote: Air-sacs were nevertheless probable given the pneumatisation of the vertebrae.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was a bipedal predator with a horizontal hip balanced by a long tail.
facts.quote: Scipionyx era un depredador bípedo, su grupa horizontal equilibrada por una cola larga.

facts.statement: Its body was likely covered in primitive feathers, but no skin or feather remains have been found in the fossil.
facts.quote: Su cuerpo probablemente estaba cubierto por plumas primitivas, pero estas no se han encontrado en el fósil, es decir, sin restos de piel.

facts.statement: Only one juvenile specimen of Scipionyx has been discovered, notable for the preservation of soft tissues in its internal organs.
facts.quote: Sólo se ha descubierto un ejemplar juvenil, notable por la preservación del tejido blando de sus órganos internos.

facts.statement: The juvenile specimen measured 23 cm in length and 15 cm in height, leading to an estimate that an adult reached 2 meters in length, 0.70 meters in height, and weighed 20 kilograms.
facts.quote: El ejemplar medía 23 centímetros de largo y 15 de alto, por lo que se estima que un adulto llegó a los 2 metros de largo, 0,70 de alto y a pesar 20 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The holotype of Scipionyx represents a very small individual with a preserved length of only 237 millimeters.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Scipionyx representa un individuo muy pequeño, la longitud conservada es de solo 237 milímetros.

facts.statement: In 2011, dal Sasso & Maganuco estimated its total length, including the missing tail section, at 461 millimeters.
facts.quote: En 2011, dal Sasso & Maganuco estimó su longitud total, incluida la sección faltante de la cola, en 461 milímetros.

facts.statement: Scipionyx was a small bipedal predator balanced by a long tail.
facts.quote: Scipionyx era un pequeño depredador bípedo. Su rabadilla horizontal estaba equilibrada por una cola larga.

facts.statement: Dal Sasso & Maganuco considered the presence of a layer of primitive protofeathers probable, known also from some direct relatives.
facts.quote: Dal Sasso & Maganuco consideraron probable la presencia de una capa de protoplumas primitivas, conocidas también por algunos parientes directos.

facts.statement: A 2011 study established eight unique derived traits or autapomorphies by which Scipionyx differed from its closest relatives.
facts.quote: El estudio de 2011 estableció ocho rasgos derivados únicos o autapomorfías en las que Scipionyx difería de sus parientes más cercanos.

facts.statement: The premaxilla has five teeth.
facts.quote: El premaxillar tiene cinco dientes.

facts.statement: The wrist consists of only two superposed bones: a radial element and a lower element formed by the fusion of the first and second carpals.
facts.quote: La muñeca consta de solo dos huesos superpuestos, un elemento radial y otro inferior formado por una fusión del primer y segundo carpo.

facts.statement: The first finger is notably elongated, 23% longer than the third finger.
facts.quote: El primer dedo está notablemente alargado, un 23% más largo que el tercer dedo.

facts.statement: The holotype skull is large compared to body size and features very large eye sockets.
facts.quote: El cráneo del holotipo es grande, en comparación con el tamaño del cuerpo, y cuenta con cuencas oculares muy grandes.

facts.statement: The number of five premaxillary teeth is surprising, as a total of four is normal for compsognathids, whereas only some carnosaurs have five.
facts.quote: El número de cinco dientes premaxilares es sorprendente, ya que un total de cuatro es normal para los compsognátidos, por lo contrario, solo algunos carnosaurios tener cinco.

facts.statement: The teeth lack the typical compsognathid shape with a suddenly repeating tooth crown vertex.
facts.quote: Los dientes carecen de la forma compsognátida típica con un vértice de la corona del diente que se repite repentinamente.

facts.statement: Exceptionally, the lower maxilla tooth row extends further back than the upper maxilla tooth row.
facts.quote: Excepcionalmente, la fila de dientes del maxilar inferior se extiende más hacia atrás que la del maxilar superior.

facts.statement: The furcula is wide and roughly U-shaped with its two branches at an angle of 125 degrees.
facts.quote: La furcula es ancha y más o menos en forma de U con sus dos ramas en ángulo de 125°.

facts.statement: Its length is equal to 48% of the body length in front of the pelvis.
facts.quote: Su longitud es igual al 48% de la longitud del cuerpo por delante de la pelvis.

facts.statement: The ulna is thin and cylindrical with a length of 70% of the humerus.
facts.quote: El cúbito es delgado y cilíndrico con una longitud del 70% de la del húmero.

facts.statement: The third finger is exceptionally long for a compsognathid, at 123% of the thumb's length.
facts.quote: El tercer dedo es excepcionalmente largo para un comspognátido, con un 123 % de la longitud del pulgar.

facts.statement: A 2011 study places the phylogenetic position of Scipionyx among the coelurosaurs.
facts.quote: Este cladograma muestra la posición filogenética de Scipionyx entre los celurosaurios, de acuerdo con el estudio de 2011.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence of stomach contents confirms that Scipionyx was a predator.
facts.quote: Estos confirman lo que ya se pudo concluir a partir de sus afinidades filogenéticas y estructura general, de que Scipionyx era un depredador.

facts.statement: Eight scales and some bone fragments were found in the esophagus of the Scipionyx fossil.
facts.quote: En el tracto del esófago se encuentran presentes unas ocho escamas y algunos fragmentos óseos.

facts.statement: Small bones found in the stomach included a three-millimeter-wide ankle with five fused metatarsals, a tail vertebra, and the top of a cubit bone.
facts.quote: En la propia posición del estómago, se ve un grupo de huesos pequeños. Estos incluyen un tobillo con un metatarso de tres milímetros de ancho que consta de cinco metatarsianos unidos, una vértebra de la cola y el extremo superior de un cúbito.

facts.statement: The size of the prey bones suggests the animal was a lizard-like lepidosaur.
facts.quote: El tamaño indica la última posibilidad.

facts.statement: Two groups of lizard scales and a fish vertebra were found in the descending duodenum.
facts.quote: En el tracto descendente del duodeno están presentes dos grupos de escamas de lagarto y, más abajo, una vértebra de pez.

facts.statement: Dozens of fish vertebrae, likely from a Clupeomorpha member, were found in the jejunum.
facts.quote: El yeyuno muestra un grupo de docenas de vértebras de peces, probablemente pertenecientes a un miembro de Clupeomorpha.

facts.statement: Feces in the rectum contained skin with seventeen scales from an Osteoglosiform fish that was nine seasons old based on growth lines.
facts.quote: El tracto final del recto todavía contiene heces en las que se ve un trozo de piel que muestra diecisiete escamas de un pez Osteoglosiformes que tenía nueve temporadas, a juzgar por las líneas de crecimiento en las escamas.

facts.statement: The stomach contents sequence included a four-to-five-centimeter fish, a two-to-three-centimeter fish, a ten-to-twelve-centimeter lizard, a fifteen-to-forty-centimeter lepidosaurian lizard, and indeterminate vertebrates.
facts.quote: Primero un pez de cuatro a cinco centímetros de largo, en segundo lugar, un pez más pequeño de dos a tres centímetros, luego un lagarto de diez a doce centímetros de largo, luego una lagartija lepidosauriana de quince a cuarenta centímetros de largo, según la identificación y finalmente algunos vertebrados indeterminados.

facts.statement: The varied diet indicates Scipionyx was an opportunistic generalist.
facts.quote: Juntos representan una dieta variada que muestra que Scipionyx era un generalista oportunista.

facts.statement: Capturing fast lizards and collecting washed-up beach fish suggests Scipionyx had good mobility.
facts.quote: El hecho de que se hubieran capturado lagartos veloces y que se hubieran recolectado peces de mar arrastrados a la orilla requiriendo un patrullaje prolongado de la línea de inundación, ambos indican una buena movilidad.

facts.statement: If the prey was forty centimeters long, it is unlikely a same-sized juvenile could have subdued it, suggesting parental care.
facts.quote: Si el animal de presa en el estómago realmente tenía cuarenta centímetros de largo, es muy poco probable que la cría del mismo tamaño hubiera podido someterlo, lo que indica el cuidado de los padres.

facts.statement: The holotype of Scipionyx is a rare example of a non-avian theropod juvenile.
facts.quote: El holotipo de Scipionyx es un raro ejemplo de cría de terópodo no aviar.

facts.statement: Youth is reflected in the proportions and low degree of ossification and fusion of several skeletal elements.
facts.quote: La juventud se refleja en las proporciones y el bajo grado de osificación y fusión de varios elementos esqueléticos.

facts.statement: The most obvious juvenile trait is a relatively large and short head.
facts.quote: El rasgo juvenil más obvio es la cabeza relativamente grande y corta.

facts.statement: The unclosed fontanelle suggests an age limit of about five weeks.
facts.quote: El hecho de que la fontanela aún no se haya cerrado, plantea un límite superior de edad de unas cinco semanas.

facts.statement: The lack of tooth replacement indicates an even lower age limit, as tooth replacement in Archosaurs begins after a few weeks at most.
facts.quote: Un límite aún más bajo está indicado por la falta de reemplazo de dientes, que con Archosauria comienza después de unas pocas semanas a más tardar.

facts.statement: The yolk sac size indicates a probable age of three days with an upper limit of one week.
facts.quote: La edad más exacta viene dada por el tamaño del saco vitelino, que indica una edad probable de tres días, con un límite superior de una semana.

facts.statement: Despite its young age, the juvenile could walk, as shown by the complete ossification of the ilium.
facts.quote: A pesar de su corta edad, la cría podía caminar, como lo demuestra la completa osificación del hueso ilíaco.

facts.statement: Scipionyx belongs to the parent group Compsognathidae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Compsognathidae

facts.statement: Scipionyx is classified in the family Compsognathidae.
facts.quote: Family: Compsognathidae

facts.statement: Scipionyx is classified in the class Reptilia.

facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (113.2 to 110.1 million years ago)

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of Scipionyx has been recorded.
facts.quote: Fossil occurrences recorded: 1
